summary: Worker trust-boundary closure: production workers now require a separate OS identity with enforced filesystem confinement and process containment (fail-closed startup, cross-uid scratch ownership); worker termination is verified process-tree teardown with an env-carried containment token; worker error data can no longer select control-flow exceptions in the supervisor (bounded error codes replace dynamic class resolution); overflow results are read through a pinned directory descriptor with O_NOFOLLOW so path swaps and replacement races cannot redirect integrity checks. Production startup wires the profile in and takes backend_id from the verified manifest.
